summary:
The Celsius-to-Fahrenheit app is built on `desk:apps:temp` (22 lines) and tested: digits, `-` and `.` build the text, Backspace deletes, other keys are ignored, `2` shows `F: 35.6`, `-4.5` shows `F: 23.9`, and `1-` shows `F: ?`.

I took "row 2 shows `F:` followed by the number" to mean the `F:` label with the converted value, and I used `is_number` for the "not a number" check. The app reads and changes no pages, and no other pages were created or changed.

files.desk:apps:temp:
app 'Celsius to Fahrenheit'
task start()
  give {t: ''}
done
task key(s, k)
  set t to s.t
  when k is 'backspace' or ('0123456789-.' has k)
    set t to edit_text(t, k)
  done
  give {t: t}
done
task draw(s)
  title('Celsius to Fahrenheit')
  show(1, 3, 'C: ' & s.t, 'bright')
  when is_number(s.t)
    set f to number(s.t) * 9 / 5 + 32
    show(2, 3, 'F: ' & f)
  otherwise
    show(2, 3, 'F: ?')
  done
  help('Digits - . type   Backspace deletes')
done
